Options

A · Slide-in sleeve simplest baseline

One printed tube, closed at one end. The board slides in on two ledges; the port slot runs out to the open end so the connectors pass.

Mechanism
board slides in along its length; the plugged-in cables key it in place
Layout
one-piece sleeve, open at one short end
Load path
board -> ledges -> sleeve floor -> desk
Process
FDM, printed standing on the closed end, no bridges

Fit and stack-up

B · Tray and press-fit lid

The board drops into an open tray onto two ledges; a lid with a locating lip presses into the tray's rim.

Mechanism
board drops in from above; a friction-fit lid lip closes the tray
Layout
clamshell split horizontally: tray below, lid above
Load path
board -> ledges -> tray floor -> desk
Process
FDM, two flat prints (tray open side up, lid upside down)

Fit and stack-up

CheckArithmeticResultMargin
Lid lip stays above the connectorsz_b + pcb_t + comp_h < tray_h - lip_h✓ 6.8 < 7.30.5
Connector overhang drops through the open-top port slotports_span ≤ win_l✓ 51.2 ≤ 531.8
Lip wall is at least two 0.45 perimeterslip_t ≥ 2 * 0.45✓ 1.2 ≥ 0.90.3
Ledges under the board stay on its bare edge striprail + gap ≤ edge_clear✓ 1.5 ≤ 20.5
Port opening spans HDMI to PWR USBwin_l ≥ ports_span✓ 53 ≥ 51.21.8
A plug's shell reaches its socket through the wallwall + gap - conn_over ≤ plug_reach✓ 1.4 ≤ 20.6

What it costs against A

  • +1 printed part (3 parts against 2)
  • +1 print job
  • 2.2 mm taller, 1.9 mm longer
  • the lid can be lost; A has nothing loose

C · Screwed sandwich

The board is clamped between a base plate and a cover plate by four M2.5 screws through its own mounting holes. The sides stay open.

Mechanism
four screws clamp cover, board and base through the board's mounting holes
Layout
two plates with posts, open on all four sides
Load path
board -> base posts -> base plate -> desk
Process
FDM, two flat prints, plus four bought screws

Fit and stack-up

CheckArithmeticResultMargin
Thread engagement is at least 1.5 × the screw diameterscrew_len - (cover_t + spacer_h + pcb_t) ≥ 1.5 * screw_d✓ 4.2 ≥ 3.750.45
Screw tip stays inside the basescrew_len - (cover_t + spacer_h + pcb_t) ≤ z_b✓ 4.2 ≤ 4.20
Cover spacers are taller than the tallest componentspacer_h > comp_h✓ 3.6 > 3.20.4
Posts stay on the board's Ø6 mounting padspost_d ≤ 6.0✓ 5.5 ≤ 60.5

What it costs against A

  • +1 printed part and +4 screws (7 parts against 2)
  • needs a screwdriver: misses R4
  • open sides: no protection from the edges
  • +1 print job
